newsitems.title: New Transfigured Skills in Path of Exile: Curse of the Allflame
newsitems.author: Natalia_GGG
newsitems.contents:
For the past few Path of Exile expansions, we've continued expanding the roster of Transfigured Skills, bringing unique alternate versions to gems that didn't yet have one. Each offers a fresh way to play a familiar skill, opening up new build possibilities.

Today, we're giving you a first look at two more Transfigured Skills arriving in Path of Exile: Curse of the Allflame - the Holy Hammers of Spirals & Reap of Butchery. Check out the highlights in the video below!

[previewyoutube=pNCEZ8EJwA0;full][/previewyoutube]

To see these and much more - join us for the Path of Exile: Curse of the Allflame livestream on July 16 (PDT) at [url=twitch.tv/pathofexile]twitch.tv/pathofexile[/url].

newsitems.title: A series of surprise updates has polished Path of Exile 2 into a juggernaut that's about to shake up the action RPG genre later this year
newsitems.author: Tyler Colp
newsitems.contents: Grinding Gear Games is on a roll. Despite announcing that the most recent expansion to Path of Exile 2 would be its last update before it leaves early access later this year, the patches keep coming... Read more.

newsitems.title: Path of Exile's most unique league is back with a chaotic, class-fusing twist
newsitems.author: editor@pcgamesn.com
newsitems.contents:
A new Path of Exile event is about to start, as developer Grinding Gear Games attempts to test the limits of just how much action RPG it's possible to squeeze into your life. The new mini-league is designed to carry us over until the reveal of PoE 3.29 in mid-July, and it combines the squad-building strategy of Trial of the Ancestors with the weird and wonderful alternate class ancestries of Legacy of Phrecia. The result promises to be one of the most chaotic PoE events ever - if you can make space for it in your schedule.

Read the full story on PCGamesN: Path of Exile's most unique league is back with a chaotic, class-fusing twist

newsitems.title: Play the Return of the Ancestors Event on June 25th PDT
newsitems.author: Natalia_GGG
newsitems.contents:
The Ancestors have heard your call. The beloved Trial of the Ancestors mechanics return to Path of Exile in a three-week event starting June 25 (PDT)! Harness the power of Phrecian Ascendancy classes and new Tattoos to challenge the legendary Karui chieftains.

[previewyoutube=8EhLeM2fuMU;full][/previewyoutube]
[list]
[*] [b]Start Date:[/b] 3PM June 25th PDT
[*] [b]End Date: [/b]3PM July 16th PDT 
[*] Based on: Mirage
[*] Standard, Hardcore, Standard Solo Self-Found and Hardcore Solo Self-Found versions available. The event also has a Ruthless mode available which uses the same Ascendancy Classes as non-Ruthless versions.
[*] This event is not voided. Items and characters will transfer to parent leagues at the end of the event. Upon migration, your characters’ Ascendancy points will be respecced and you'll be assigned one of the core Ascendancy classes.
[/list]
In Return of the Ancestors event, you will find silver coins in areas across Wraeclast, which you can use to gain passage to the Karui Afterlife where you will compete against Karui tribes by assembling your own team of warriors. Battle their chieftains in the tournament to earn valuable rewards! If you have not played the original Trial of the Ancestors league, check out the announcement here for more information on how the mechanics work.

The legacy Trial of the Ancestors Tattoos are making a comeback in this event. In addition, we are introducing a new variety of Tattoos that can be applied to your Ascendancy Classes. These Tattoos are exclusive to the Return of the Ancestors. Here is an example:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5193306/42e329dd4c75297cca913bcfcdee2fd5d3d6e3f6.jpg[/img]

Please note that during the event, Tattoos will not be available as a reward through Kingsmarch shipping.

All regular Ascendancy classes in Return of the Ancestors are replaced with 19 Phrecian Ascendancy classes (please note that the Reliquarian Ascendancy does not have a Phrecian counterpart and is disabled in this event). The balance for these classes remains the same as in the previous Phrecia event. Check out [url=https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/3722512]this post[/url] to find out more about the Phrecian Ascendancies and [url=https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/3908674]this post[/url] for the balance changes we made in the previous event. Note that the Atlas Idols system will not be available in the Return of the Ancestors.

[h3]Guaranteed Mystery Box[/h3]
By killing Kitava in Act Ten, you will be automatically awarded a Return of the Ancients Mystery Box. This is a guaranteed prize that's only available once per account per event. Killing Kitava multiple with multiple characters in the same event will not grant multiple mystery boxes.

[h3]How to Join?[/h3]
When the event begins on June 25th, just create a new character in either Standard or Hardcore Return of the Ancestors event on the Character Selection screen. If you want to play SSF, don’t forget to select this option on the screen.

[h3]FAQ[/h3]
[b]Can I play my existing character?[/b]
No, you’ll need to make a new character.

[b]Can I change my Ascendancy class during the event?[/b]
Yes.

[b]Is Reliquarian Ascendancy available in this event?[/b]
No, as it doesn’t have a Phrecian counterpart.

[b]Will Forbidden Tattoos grant passives from regular Ascendancies or Phrecian Ascendancies?[/b]
They will grant passives from the regular Ascendancies.

[b]What passives will Forbidden Tattoos grant in Ruthless?[/b]
They will grant passives from the Ruthless versions of the regular Ascendancies.

[b]Can I apply a Ranger Ascendancy Tattoo as a Witch?[/b]
Yes.

[b]Will I be able to finish my remaining Mirage Challenges in this event?[/b]
Yes.

Have fun, Exiles!

newsitems.title: Path of Exile 2 director says players exploiting system to become in-game millionaires 'ruined Christmas for me' and joked that he's 'lost all sympathy' for everyone who took advantage of it
newsitems.author: Tyler Colp
newsitems.contents: Path of Exile 2's player trading economy crumbled in its last season the moment word got out about a clever technique that would net you so much loot you could become an in-game millionaire in a few days. It was so catastrophic that developer Grinding Gear Games had to interrupt its holiday break to fix it... Read more.

newsitems.title: Nobody needs to grind for 100 hours to see how Path of Exile 2 has redefined the action RPG loot hunt
newsitems.author: Tyler Colp
newsitems.contents: Path of Exile 2 has taken the throne. Not only is it a worthy sequel, its latest update earns it the right to have "next-generation action RPG" in its official description. I've played obscene amounts of these types of games and have never seen one quite so ambitious. Certainly not one that is still in early access and doesn't even have a finished campaign yet... Read more.

newsitems.title: A single crab has the third highest player kill count in Path of Exile 2
newsitems.author: Tyler Colp
newsitems.contents: You gotta hand it to the brave few who willingly risk it all playing an early access game like Path of Exile 2 on hardcore difficulty, where a single death permanently ends your character. If you're not getting squashed by a giant monkey boss, you're taking your chances with whatever unfinished parts of the game could be your end... Read more.

newsitems.title: Path of Exile 2 player willingly deletes level 100 character to become world first martyr, buffing everyone in the game: 'That was the coolest thing I've seen in a videogame in a very long time'
newsitems.author: Tyler Colp
newsitems.contents: Late last week, one of the highest level Path of Exile 2 players found something they've never seen before: a mysterious chamber in an empty room. Grinding Gear Games added a lot of new stuff in the recent Return of the Ancients update, like hidden rooms and powerful secret items, but it took one courageous player to figure out what happens when you enter this ominous chamber... Read more.

newsitems.title: Path of Exile 3.29 Expansion Timeline
newsitems.author: Natalia_GGG
newsitems.contents:
We’re in the fourth month of Path of Exile: Mirage, so it’s time to talk about the next big update for Path of Exile!

The release date for 3.29 has been set in stone for quite some time, so without further ado, Path of Exile 3.29 will launch on [b]July 24 at 1 PM PDT[/b], with GGG Live taking place on [b]July 16 at 1 PM PDT[/b].

In the meantime, we'll also be hosting a special event, so keep an eye out for more details! We'll share more information in due course, and we hope to see you all at the live reveal in a few weeks!

The Mirage Challenge League will end on July 20 at 3 PM PDT, so there are still several weeks left to complete any remaining challenges if you haven't finished them yet.

See you soon!

newsitems.title: Path of Exile 2 raises the bar for all other action RPGs, and it's not even finished yet
newsitems.author: Tyler Colp
newsitems.contents: Path of Exile is one of the most complex action RPGs around. Look up a screenshot of its gigantic skill tree and you'll understand its maximalist approach to character build customization. It isn't a game about leveling up and collecting loot so much as it is about using programmer logic to design the most effective monster-slaying machine possible... Read more.

newsitems.title: Path of Exile 2's 1.0 release won't need to accommodate other game releases, director says—except GTA 6: 'That's a Goliath I don't want to take on quite frankly'
newsitems.author: Tyler Colp
newsitems.contents: Path of Exile director Jonathan Rogers says he's never worried that much about the timing of other game releases—particularly other seasonal action RPGs—when it comes to scheduling major updates for his own game. But this year, Path of Exile 2's 1.0 release will likely be within a few weeks of the one game that has him reconsidering this approach: Grand Theft Auto 6... Read more.

newsitems.title: Path of Exile 2's 'biggest expansion ever' reworks its entire post-campaign grind for new and returning players alike
newsitems.author: Tyler Colp
newsitems.contents: Path of Exile 2 has one of the best action RPG campaigns out there, and it's not even finished yet. It wastes no time pushing you through each act as you gear up and watch the world of Wraeclast unravel. But when it's over, you're handed a gigantic world map filled with dozens of locations and no advice on where to start your endgame grind... Read more.

newsitems.title: Path of Exile 2's massive Return of the Ancients expansion will be its last major update before it leaves early access later this year: 'I want to get this game finished, I really, really do'
newsitems.author: Tyler Colp
newsitems.contents: Jonathan Rogers, game director of Path of Exile 2, is eager for all the questions about when the game will leave early access to finally stop. Its next update, Return of the Ancients, reworks the entire post-campaign grind into a guided experience with quests and boss fights, a huge overhaul that Rogers says will be the last before PoE 2 hits 1.0 later this year... Read more.
